biggest_catch: LEGO cash on the spot is real, but completeness is everything: missing pieces or minifigures crater the offer, and a store overstocked on your set can simply say no.
catches: Offers vary by set, completeness (missing pieces cut value), condition, demand, and each store's stock needs.
The store can decline items it already has in stock - acceptance is not guaranteed.
Bulk/unsorted LEGO pays far less per piece than complete sets with minifigures.
Offers and accepted categories differ by location.
Resale catch-all: value varies by condition and demand; quotes and market prices can change; fees or shipping can reduce your actual proceeds.

eligibility: Must own the items; store locations only; offers vary by location.
maximize: Sort before you go: complete sets with minifigures and instructions fetch far more than unsorted bulk. Call ahead - each store's stock needs differ, and overstocked sets get declined.

Numeric keys are example-based estimates for a typical single item, labeled per lane rules; official terms give no payout floor and state value varies by condition and demand - actual offers are per-item and can be $0 if the item is not accepted.
payout_quote: We pay on-the-spot cash or store credit for LEGO sets, minifigures, and bulk pieces; offers vary by condition, demand, stock levels, and location.

repeatable.cadence: You can do this once per LEGO lot you own - it is bounded by the sets, minifigures, and bulk pieces you already have, not a daily income stream.

steps: Bring your LEGO sets, minifigures, or bulk pieces to a Bricks & Minifigs store
Staff assess condition, completeness, demand, and current stock
Get cash or store credit immediately
timing: On-the-spot cash or store credit after in-store assessment.
who_pays: Bricks & Minifigs - the store pays you directly on the spot, in cash or store credit.
who_qualifies: You must own the items and be able to visit a Bricks & Minifigs store in person. Offers vary by location.
work_available: Yes - stores were buying on the spot as of 2026-09-23. But each store only buys what it needs: a store overstocked on your set can simply say no.
what_gets_accepted: Staff assess condition, completeness, demand, and current stock. Completeness is everything - missing pieces or minifigures crater the offer, and unsorted bulk pays far less per piece than complete sets with minifigures and instructions.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees; no shipping since you bring items in. Your unpaid time is sorting beforehand (completeness pays) and the trip to the store - call ahead since stock needs differ by location.
when_cash_arrives: Real cash or store credit on the spot, immediately after the in-store assessment.
